title: Realization maps the fixed pullback summand equation
statement: For finite R, p:X→Y, P,Q and a+b=n, applying scalar realization to the fixed inverse-image injection formula gives the mapped source injection followed by the mapped fixed comparison component, equal to the mapped ordinary inverse-image tensorator followed by the mapped pulled-back injection.

proof.text: Apply scalar realization to the proved fixed-coefficient injection formula and use preservation of composition on its two sides. This is entirely proved in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteScalarTensorPullback_mapped_fixed_summand
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (P Q : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R))) ℤ)
    (a b n : ℤ) (h : a + b = n) :
    ((ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p) ⋙
      (sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence X R).functor).map
        (CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor P Q (curriedTensor _) a b n h) ≫
    (sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence X R).functor.map
      (((finiteScalarFixedComplexTensorPullbackForCoefficients
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).app (P, Q)).f n) =
    (sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence X R).functor.map
        (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ
          (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p) (P.X a) (Q.X b)) ≫
    (sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence X R).functor.map
      (CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor
        (((ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj P)
        (((ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
        (curriedTensor _) a b n h)
